## 2025-02-23 - XSS via DangerouslySetInnerHTML
**Vulnerability:** The `MathModal.jsx` component rendered raw HTML content (`data.content`, `data.solved`, and `data.shortcomings`) using React's `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` without any prior sanitization.
**Learning:** Even internal static content or content generated by standard Markdown/HTML converters must be treated as untrusted and explicitly sanitized if rendered dynamically to prevent XSS payloads from executing, particularly in educational or interactive tools.
**Prevention:** Always wrap variables passed into `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` with `DOMPurify.sanitize()` (or an equivalent sanitization function).
